name: BraemarHealth Hillside Clinic · Praya detail pass
description: A postmodern care building with a stepped entrance arch, warm masonry, a sculpted cornice and smoked glazing. The cyan-and-lime medical mark is the sole exterior identity; the three furnished care floors are retained. September 9 successor: recessed glazing, projecting sills, connected thin blocks, framed signage and supported finishing details; original layout and identity retained.
